top_candidates.generated_headline: Context Engineering Goes Beyond Length: Structure and Strategic Forgetting Matter
top_candidates.summary: Effective context management requires more than just trimming length; it depends heavily on how information is organized to support attention mechanisms and dependency lengths. Furthermore, just like human cognition, introducing 'strategic forgetting' rather than striving for a flawless memory helps prevent models from getting weighed down by conflict and noise. Quote: As we focus more on memory, we also need to think about strategic forgetting. Over time, overly precise memories become conflicted and messy, and nobody has yet figured out how to handle this.
